Profibus is open bus
standard for industrial automation. It defines characteristic signs of serial
industrial bus, through which one could interconnect peripheral instruments in
the lowest automation level and control PLC of middle level. Principle transfer
medium is the standard metallic twisted line according to US standard EIA
RS-485.

In Profibus network 
there could be two types of stations: Active 
stations - MASTER and passive stations - SLAVE, Architecture of transfer
protocol is oriented to reference model OSI, responding to international
standard ISO 7498.

Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must be performed every 6 
months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Hesham El Sayed Mohamed El Assy, tested by eng. Mohamed Gad 
 El Rab Hawad at 15 Feb. 2003, 
 reviewed by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abdel Momem El-Emam, accepted by general 
 director eng. Farouk Awad Aly, and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of 
 Talkha power plant.
